content.rendered:
Credits

Since the beginning of the project, some companies made some donations to the project in term of hardware/internet, or funded the development of some code.

We gratefully acknowledge the following organizations for their valuable contributions to the ntop project:

  • ABIServizi – Enhancement of the sFlow plugin

  • Agilent – Donation of a QA robot

  • APAT – Support for core code development

  • Centro Serra, University of Pisa – Project hosting

  • Cisco Systems – Implementation of iSCSI and FibreChannel support

  • cPacket Networks Inc. – Support for 10 Gbit traffic monitoring

  • Commsquare – Enhancements to PF_RING

  • CNR – Support for WAN traffic analysis

  • MPS – ntop enhancements for WAN deployments

  • InMon Inc. – Donation of an sFlow-enabled switch

  • Loria – Implementation of IPv6 support

  • MBI – Enhancement of the NetFlow plugin

  • Plixer – Registration and legal support for ntop trademarks

  • SUSE – Support for SUSE Linux compatibility

If we forgot to add you to this list, please let us know.
